top_concerns: No compute/token-matched Stage-1 control: gains may come from 26B extra in-domain training tokens rather than video-mined data
No ablation of GPT-5 inner monologues vs IDM-recovered actions/parameters, so the source of the gain is unisolated
Weak absolute OSWorld results (14-16%) with no comparison to existing open 7B CUAs (OpenCUA, UI-TARS); baseline looks under-tuned
Long-horizon/test-time-scaling claim rests on single 50-step runs within the range of run-to-run variance
Noisy IDM labels (66% parameter accuracy, lenient any-overlap detection metric) with no study of noise impact; possible AgentNet train/test overlap
